description: This file defines a Java interface 'PolicyCommand' that represents commands related to policies within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures, default methods, constants, and an inner class 'JsonFields' for JSON schema field definitions.

classes.name: PolicyCommand
classes.description: An interface that aggregates all commands related to policies, parameterized with a type T. It extends Command and WithEntityType interfaces and provides constants, default methods, and an inner class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: PolicyCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions for specific JSON fields used in PolicyCommand's JSON representation, notably the 'policyId' field.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for policy commands.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy entity ID associated with the command.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns an array indicating that PolicyCommands support only JSON Schema Version 2.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for Policy commands.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers for the command.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type associated with policies.
